items: Mix butter, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs thoroughly in a large bowl.
Combine flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt in a separate bowl. Blend dry ingredients into butter mixture.
Meanwhile, mix 3 Tbsp sugar and 3 tsp cinnamon in a small bowl.
Scoop 1-inch globs of dough into the sugar/cinnamon mixture. Coat by gently rolling balls of dough in the sugar mixture.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet, and bake 8-10 minutes.
